_comment: Same shape as weights_iris.json, for a binary classifier. breast_cancer is binary, so sklearn gives coef_ shape (1, n_features) — one row, not two. The intercept vector therefore has exactly 1 entry. This is the single most common reason a correct file is rejected.
_iris_note: weights_iris.json has 3 coef rows because iris has 3 classes. A binary dataset has 1 row. If you got 'intercept length 2 must match coef rows 1', the file was written for a 3-class model.
